title: PSNetRules State sidecar
description: PSNetRules bookkeeping for managed Firewall Rules and logical-to-Windows NRPT Name mappings. State schema version 1 is the current sidecar format.

nrptRules.description: Maps each PSNetRules NRPT logical ID to the corresponding Windows-generated rule Name.

managedFirewallRules.description: Names of Firewall Rules explicitly adopted for management.
